messages:
alex chen: Quick heads-up — planning a small canary to enable flash-attn fastpath + speculative-decoding v2 on production pool `runtime-gpu-eu-1` tonight at 22:00 PT. Scope: 5% traffic, only customers tagged `canary-ml`. Need final thumbs before I schedule.
maya singh: Are we gating by input length? spec-decode v2 should be limited to <=1024 tokens, right?
samir rao: Correct. Also we should keep the KV cache prefix tweak OFF for the canary to avoid potential cache stampedes.
diane hu: Can we start at 1% and then go to 5% after 30m? prefer slower ramp for safety.
alex chen: Proposed plan: 1% -> 5% after 20m if checks pass (p95 latency within SLO, error rate <0.2%). Auto-rollback on anomalies. obs-bot will spin up a temporary dashboard. @nick park can you watch metrics during rollout?
nick park: I can take watch. Also please link the PR for the feature flag config — I left a note about kernel fallback order.
alex chen: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4523 — pinged reviewers.
samir rao: Guardrail details: auto-fallback to baseline kernel if p50 increases >20ms OR p99 >200ms. Deploy-bot will flip the flag via the feature flags API.
alex chen: Rollback command (if needed):
```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.ai/v1/toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"feature":"fastpath_specdec_v2","enabled":false,"scope":"runtime-gpu-eu-1"}'
```
obs-bot: Temporary dashboard created: https://obs.redwood.ai/d/abc/fastpath-specdec-canary — alert `fastpath-specdec-canary-latency` on p95/p99 breaches.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: 2026-03-15T22:00:00-07:00 (CID: roll-1769456789). Steps: toggle -> 1% -> wait 20m checks -> bump to 5%.
maya singh: :eyes: I approve, leaving a comment on the PR to nudge the kernel fallback ordering change.
diane hu: I'll be on call 22:00-23:00 PT to handle any immediate rollbacks.
alex chen: Also — keeping KV cache tweak disabled for canary. We'll enable it only after 24h of stable metrics.
nick park: LGTM. I'll open a postmortem template in #postmortems so it's ready if something goes sideways.
samir rao: :thumbsup:
